title: Fantasy Foosball Weekly: Year 8, 2026 Week 6 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, the model separates the contenders from the teams needing a major turn.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

matchups.headline: Payton and Kohlt meet in a volatile playoff swing
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters Week 6 ranked eighth at 2-3, with a 53.1% modeled playoff chance. Kohlt’s 3-2 team, kohlt, sits sixth but has a lower 45.0% chance. The model makes this a major opportunity for both: Payton rises to 64.6% with a win and falls to 36.1% with a loss, while Kohlt moves to 62.9% or 32.8%. In this early-season, six-spot race, the matchup carries swings of 28.5 and 30.1 percentage points. Payton’s two-time champion history adds league context.

matchups.headline: Andy holds strong position while Cooper needs a breakthrough
matchups.paragraph: Andy’s Long dong silvers brings a 4-1 record and the third-place ranking into Week 6, backed by an 86.1% modeled playoff chance. Cooper’s Jack MeHoff is ninth at 2-3, and the model gives it only a 0.9% chance. A win lifts Andy to 90.2%, while a loss still leaves 73.5%; Cooper moves only from 0.9% to 2.2% with a win and drops to 0.4% with a loss. The 16.7-point swing matters for Andy, while Cooper’s 1.8-point swing reflects a much narrower path. Cooper is a 2022 champion.

matchups.headline: The top two collide with playoff odds already near certainty
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs, ranked first at 4-1, meets Evan’s second-ranked Bonnie Blue 42, also 4-1. The model gives Kane a 99.3% playoff chance and Evan 98.5%, so this showdown brings prestige more than major playoff volatility. A Blueballs win changes the estimate to 99.8%, while a loss brings it to 98.8%. Bonnie Blue 42 moves to 99.4% with a win and 97.7% with a loss. Their modeled swings are just 1.0 and 1.7 points, respectively. Evan’s team also carries 2023 champion status in league lore.

matchups.headline: Kade has meaningful ground to gain against Joey’s long shot
matchups.paragraph: Kade’s CheesusJesus enters ranked seventh at 3-2, with a 36.5% modeled playoff chance in the six-spot race. Joey’s Off Constantly is 11th at 1-4, and the model gives it just 0.7%. Kade would rise to 44.7% with a win but fall to 23.1% with a loss, a 21.6-point swing. Joey’s outcomes are 1.3% and 0.3%, only a 1.0-point swing. The matchup therefore carries substantially more modeled consequence for Kade, while Joey’s 2024 champion history remains the notable league backdrop.

matchups.headline: Parker needs momentum against defending champion Alex
matchups.paragraph: Parker’s My BallDak hurts is ranked 10th at 1-4, with a 15.1% modeled playoff chance. Alex’s I love big TD’s sits fifth at 3-2 and owns a 72.9% chance, making this a significant test for both sides. Parker rises to 24.8% with a win and falls to 7.6% with a loss. Alex moves to 82.4% after a win or 60.5% after a loss, a 21.9-point swing. Parker’s 17.2-point swing also matters in this volatile early-season race. Alex is the 2025 champion; Parker is the 2019 inaugural champion and league Public Enemy.

matchups.headline: CJ’s strong position meets Brae’s impossible model margin
matchups.paragraph: Brae’s Ogles Outlaws is 0-5 and ranked 12th, with a modeled playoff chance of 0%. CJ’s cjbroadway23 is fourth at 3-2 and carries a 92.1% chance to reach the six-team playoff. The model gives Brae 0% whether the result is a win or loss, so the supplied odds show no change or modeled swing. CJ rises to 93.6% with a win and falls to 82.5% with a loss, an 11.1-point swing. The matchup’s playoff implications therefore center on CJ protecting a strong position, while Brae faces a model that offers no remaining percentage-point path.
